items.q: The interviewer mentions Al Cooper as a hometown boy from Florida who originated the Savoy Sultans, but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond or comment on this specific individual in the provided text.

ctx.x: Right yeah. And he's working a lot again and Panama Francis has that revival of the Savoy Sultans is working a lot. George Kelly as a matter of fact.
Yeah George Kelly, they're all hometown boys. Out of Florida ... So is Al Cooper. He's out of Florida, the one who originated the Savoy Sultan. Al Cooper and the Savoy Sultans.
We can't end this interview without talking a little bit about your friend Edgar Battle. We mentioned him in passing a number of times but we never really delved.
